statement_form: IntMul.KappaBound (1 / 2 ^ 182): one deterministic k-tape Turing machine (k >= 2: a read-only input tape, an output tape and k-2 work tapes, a fixed finite alphabet, Montanaro conventions) that for every n >= 1 and all x, y in {0,1}^n halts on input x#y with the output bin_2n(val(x) val(y)), in worst-case time at most c n (lg n)^(1 - kappa) for n >= n0, with lg n = max(ceil(log2 n), 1) and kappa = 2^-182. That is OpenAI Theorem 1 and our page statement (a Turing machine with a fixed finite alphabet and a fixed number of one-dimensional tapes). Definitions Def_IntMul_MultitapeModel pinned by hash; it has no instances, notations or axioms (reviewed 2026-10-19).
